# Sajeetharan Sinnathurai

> Principal Program Manager at Microsoft focused on developer tooling, Azure Cosmos DB, coding agents, developer experience, and cloud platforms.

This is the agent-readable index for https://www.sajeetharan.dev. Public resources are read-only and require no API key.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/): Biography, focus areas, featured work, and community contributions.
- [Developer portal](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/developers): Quickstarts, endpoint documentation, CLI usage, and a read-only sandbox.
- [Blog](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/blogs): Long-form technical articles.
- [Projects](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/projects): Open-source and developer-tooling projects.
- [Talks](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/talks): Conference sessions and recordings.
- [Awards](https://www.sajeetharan.dev/awards): Professional and community recognition.
